title: 第二章 民族与市场之间
originalTitle: Chapter Two · Between Nation and Market

zh: 在20世纪第一个和第二个十年的内战与日本渗透之中，满洲从人口稀少的腹地转变为高度商业化的地区。农业扩张支撑了这一时期的经济繁荣。民族权力与殖民权力分别鼓励了来自华北与朝鲜的农民移民。当中朝移民因歉收与政治危机而被逐离家乡时，他们被卷入日本与中国民族权力之间的政治斗争。日本租借辽东半岛与南满铁路后，其对满洲腹地的渗透依赖朝鲜移民。为扩大汉族人口并巩固对该地区的主权，清朝及其后的民国政府为汉族农民移居满洲提供了便利。
en: In the midst of civil war and Japanese penetration during the first and second decades of the twentieth century, Manchuria was transformed from a sparsely populated hinterland into a highly commercialized region. Agricultural expansion was the backbone of its prosperous economy. The national and colonial powers had encouraged peasant migration from North China and Korea, respectively. When the Chinese and Korean migrants were displaced from their hometowns by crop failures and political crises, they were caught up in the political struggles between Japan and Chinese national powers. After Japan leased the Liaodong Peninsula and the South Manchuria Railway, its penetration into inner Manchuria relied on Korean migrants. To expand the Han Chinese population and bolster its sovereignty over the region, the Qing and subsequent Republican governments of China facilitated the migration of Han Chinese peasants to Manchuria.

zh: 这些民族与殖民争端有三个重心转移的特征：从政治到社会、从中央到地方、从围绕日本渗透的争夺到围绕朝鲜移民的争夺。中日政府1915年签订的《南满洲及东部内蒙古条约》，把日本臣民的土地所有权与租借权界定为日中之间的主要争夺点。尽管存在对该条约的政治反对，但直到1931年，更持续的反殖民政治关乎社会领域并聚焦土地交易。中国臣民与日本（朝鲜）臣民之间的契约成为中国民族形成的基石。民族与殖民争端从政治领域向社会领域的这一转移，反映了日本的渗透政治——一种从取得土地、扩张警察与军事存在到确立完全主权的渐进扩张策略。
en: Three shifts of emphasis characterized these national and colonial disputes: from political to social, from central to local, and from contention over Japanese penetration to contention over Korean migration. The Treaty on South Manchuria and East Inner Mongolia, which the Chinese and Japanese governments signed in 1915, delineated landownership and leasing rights by Japanese subjects as a primary site of contention between Japan and China. Although there was political opposition to the treaty, until 1931 the more persistent anticolonial politics concerned the social sphere and focused on land transactions. Contracts between Chinese and Japanese (Korean) subjects became the cornerstone of Chinese nation formation. This shift of national and colonial disputes from the political to the social arena reflected Japanese osmotic politics—a strategy of gradual expansion from the acquisition of land and expansion of police and military presence to the establishment of full sovereignty.

zh: 社会争端从中央政府层面移向满洲地方（中国东北三省）。该地区中国首席行政长官张作霖建立起相对的行政自主，迫使日本重新谈判1915年条约的条款。在满洲，东北三省政府（下文称东北政府）、中国商人与日本相互协商与争夺。他们的三角政治否定了民族与殖民政治更简单的二元对立。领土利益与资本主义发展的诉求共同左右着权力均衡。例如，当日本寻求扩张其对满洲的主权权力时，它同时援助东北政府与中国商人，而后两者的关系既含合作也含冲突。尽管彼此不和，三方确实共享对该地区资本主义发展的欲望。
en: The social disputes moved from central China to the Manchurian region (China’s three northeastern provinces). Building relative administrative autonomy, Zhang Zuolin, the chief Chinese administrator in the region, forced Japan to renegotiate the terms of the 1915 Treaty. In Manchuria, the governments of the three northeastern provinces (referred to as the Northeast government hereafter), Chinese merchants, and Japan negotiated and disputed with one another. Their triangular politics negated the simpler binary opposition of national and colonial politics. The balance of power revolved around both territorial and capitalist concerns. For instance, when Japan sought to expand its sovereign power over Manchuria, it assisted both the Northeast government and Chinese merchants, whose relations entailed both partnerships and conflicts. Despite their dissension, the three parties did share a desire for capitalist development of the region.

zh: 三角政治以两种方式塑造民族与殖民政治。第一，领土三角政治把围绕1915年条约的民族与殖民分歧转化为围绕朝鲜人的冲突。日本渗透政治支持朝鲜人及其对土地的占有，而中国人誓言驱逐他们。1920年代对朝鲜人的排斥，承诺逆转一项自19世纪中叶以来实行的中国政策——该政策鼓励朝鲜人入籍为中国国民。1920年代满洲的民族政治使中国移民与朝鲜人对立：前者作为国民，后者作为反民族者。中国移民作为东北政府所代表的中国民族成员的身份转化，以规制他们与朝鲜人的土地交易为前提。排斥朝鲜人在满洲取得相应资格的法律，不同于允许外国人入籍的中华民国中央法律。
en: Triangular politics shaped national and colonial politics in two ways. First, territorial triangular politics translated national and colonial disagreements over the 1915 Treaty into a conflict over Koreans. Japanese osmotic politics supported Koreans and their occupation of the land, while the Chinese vowed to evict them. The exclusion of Koreans in the 1920s pledged to reverse a Chinese policy that had been in place since the mid–nineteenth century, one that encouraged Koreans to become naturalized as Chinese nationals. National politics in Manchuria in the 1920s pitted Chinese migrants against Koreans, the former as nationals and the latter as antinationals. The transformation of Chinese migrants as members of the Chinese nation represented by the Northeast government was predicated on regulating their land transactions with Koreans. The law that excluded Koreans from Manchuria differed from the law of Central Republican China, which permitted the naturalization of foreigners.

zh: 这种三角政治重构了满洲新中国民族形成的场域。清政府之下满汉关系居于中心，而民国时期东北政府之下汉人与朝鲜人的关系变得突出。
清政权的满族创立者维持政府的满族身份，指令住在满洲的汉人采纳满族习俗。清代，朝鲜人入籍成为中国国民指的就是采纳这些习俗，主要是满族服饰与发式。民国时期，政府拥抱汉族身份并赋予满族低下地位。在满洲，中国人与朝鲜人的关系浮现为界定中国民族边界的关键原则。
en: This triangular politics reconfigured the locus of the new Chinese nation formation in Manchuria. While the relationship between Manchus and Han Chinese was central under the Qing government, the relationship between Han Chinese and Koreans became prominent under the Northeast government during the Republican period.

The Manchu founders of the Qing regime maintained the Manchu identity of the government, directing Han Chinese residents in Manchuria to adopt Manchu customs. Under the Qing, the naturalization of Koreans as Chinese referred to their adoption of such customs, mainly Manchu clothing and hairstyles. During the Republican period, the government embraced a Han Chinese identity and assigned an inferior status to the Manchus. In Manchuria, the relationship between Chinese and Koreans emerged as the crucial principle defining the boundary of the Chinese nation.

zh: 第二，三角政治在阻碍中国民族在满洲形成的同时构成资本主义发展。对朝鲜人水稻种植的兴趣迫使东北政府在执行自己的国籍法时作出让步。尽管它不断呼吁驱逐朝鲜人，却同时实施允许朝鲜人作为短期佃农与农业劳动者工作的政策。这种对朝鲜人的部分包容，对资本主义关系与中国主权的发展产生不可磨灭的影响。它在地主与佃农、劳动者的社会关系中生产民族与族群的不均衡。执行国籍法时反复作出让步使中国主权不完整。资本主义利益与领土利益之间这一棘手妥协，不能仅归因于中国地主对可能驱逐朝鲜人的抗议。相反，它内在于中国民族政治的性质，因为东北政府是土地、商业与金融机构的主要投资者。在这个意义上，认为张作霖把权力建立在封建军阀集团之上的流行看法，遮蔽了他与日本及中国商人之间雅努斯式的双面互动——他通过这种互动追求其矛盾的领土与资本主义欲望。
en: Second, triangular politics constituted capitalist development while hindering Chinese nation formation in Manchuria. Its interest in Korean rice farming compelled the Northeast government to compromise its own nationality law. Although it continuously called for the eviction of Koreans, it concomitantly implemented policies that allowed Koreans to work as short-term tenants and agricultural laborers. This partial inclusion of Koreans had indelible effects on the development of capitalist relations and Chinese sovereignty. It produced national and ethnic unevenness in the social relations of landlords and tenants and laborers. The repeated retreat from the nationality law rendered Chinese sovereignty incomplete. This knotty compromise between capitalist and territorial interests was not attributable solely to the protests of Chinese landlords against the possible expulsion of Koreans. Instead, it was intrinsic to the character of Chinese national politics because the Northeast government was the primary investor in land, commerce, and financial institutions. In this sense, the common perception that Zhang Zuolin based his power on a feudalistic warlord clique obscures his Janus-faced interactions with Japan and Chinese merchants, through which he pursued his contradictory territorial and capitalist desires.

zh: 本章探讨满洲的民族与殖民政治，以及朝鲜人在社会领域如何成为二者展开的中介。它始于对三角政治的分析，这要求修正满洲政治经济发展与中国民族形成的史学。讨论1915年条约之后，我考察日中权力围绕朝鲜人社会权利的斗争。我也处理中国民族形成的内部矛盾。
en: This chapter explores the national and colonial politics mediated by Koreans in the social sphere of Manchuria. It begins with an analysis of triangular politics, which entails a revision in the historiography of political and economic development and Chinese nation formation in Manchuria. After discussing the 1915 Treaty, I examine the struggle between the Japanese and Chinese powers over the social rights of Koreans. I also address the internal contradictions of Chinese nation formation.

zh: 权力均衡
en: the balance of power

zh: 张作霖1920年前即在满洲取得权力。1916年，他出任满洲主要地区奉天省的督军兼省长。他还获得足够权力，任命自己的部下出任吉林、黑龙江两省的省长、军事参谋长、首席秘书、财政厅长与警察厅长。主要财源是土地与矿业公司等公司，以及烟、酒、盐销售税。张统治下，三省非法截留大部分收入自用；到1920年代初，他们已停止向北京政府解送任何收入。张把满洲变为他与中国其他军阀权力斗争的军事基地。他的奉系与直系、皖系一起构成北方军阀集团，其首领是民国政府总统袁世凯。袁1916年死后，北方集团忙于内部斗争。张击败对手，于1925年成为北京政府的事实统治者。
en: Zhang Zuolin secured power in Manchuria prior to 1920. In 1916, he assumed the military and civil governorships of Fengtian Province, a principal region of Manchuria. He also gained enough power to appoint his subordinates to the posts of governors, military chiefs of staff, leading secretaries, treasurers, and police chiefs in Jilin and Heilongjiang Provinces. The principal sources of revenue were companies, such as land and mining companies, and taxes on the sale of tobacco, wine, and salt. Under Zhang’s rule, the three provinces illicitly kept a large proportion of their revenues for their own use; by the early 1920s, they had stopped remitting any revenue to the Beijing government. Zhang turned Manchuria into the military base for his power struggle with other militarists in China. His Fengtian clique, along with the Zhili and Anwei cliques, constituted the northern warlord group, whose leader was the president of the Republican government, Yuan Shikkai. After Yuan’s death in 1916, the northern group became occupied with its own internal struggles. Zhang defeated his rivals to become the de facto ruler of the Beijing government in 1925.

zh: 恰当评估张作霖的权力及其与中国商人、日本的关系，对理解满洲的民族与殖民政治很重要。惯例是把张与其子及继承人张学良对照。父亲被刻画为赌徒、土匪、机会主义剥削者与民族叛徒，儿子则被刻画为受过教育的现代爱国者、和平缔造者与民族英雄——后者组建了国共两党的抗日统一战线。
史学还把张作霖与中国商人对立：前者作为封建军阀与日本合作者，后者被描述为推动满洲经济发展的力量和抗日的民族主义者。然而张作霖的民族性与现代性不亚于同时代其他军阀。他与国内对手及日本的三角关系过于复杂，无法被民族与殖民政治的二分观念简化。张作霖、商人与日本是同床者，同时共享领土与资本主义欲望并竞争实现它们。
en: A proper assessment of Zhang Zuolin’s power and his relationship with Chinese merchants and Japan is important for understanding national and colonial politics in Manchuria. It is customary to contrast Zhang with his son and successor, Zhang Xueliang. The father is characterized as a gambler, bandit, opportunistic exploiter, and national traitor and the son as an educated modern patriot, peacemaker, and national hero who formed the anti-Japanese united front of the Kuomintang and Communist Parties.

Historiography also opposes Zhang Zuolin to the Chinese merchants, the former as a feudal militarist and Japanese collaborator and the latter as agents of Manchuria’s economic development and anti-Japanese nationalists. However, Zhang Zuolin was no less national and modern than other militarists of his time. His triangular relationship with domestic foes and Japan was too complex to be simplified by a dichotomous notion of national and colonial politics. Zhang Zuolin, merchants, and Japan were bedfellows who simultaneously shared territorial and capitalist desires and competed to fulfill them.

zh: 史学
en: Historiography

zh: 满洲史学的一个主要分析结构是军阀与资产阶级的对立：前者追求中国的领土统一，后者希望为经济稳定而把满洲从中国分离。战争被认为是张作霖东北政府的定义性特征，它把全部人力与资源导向在内战中击败对手。军阀一词预设东北政府围绕张氏奉系及其同伙的个人效忠与亲属纽带旋转。
为筹措战费，东北政府要求商人强制捐献，并经常为战争利益中止重要战略物资的贸易。东北政府经营各种省立银行，发行自己的货币，并操纵流通中十多种货币的汇率。不断的战争削弱满洲经济，造成通货膨胀、中断市场活动、并把收入从经济发展转移开。
en: A principal analytical structure in the historiography of Manchuria is the opposition of warlords and the bourgeoisie, the former pursuing the territorial unification of China and the latter hoping to separate Manchuria from China in the interest of economic stability. Warfare is considered to have been a defining feature of Zhang Zuolin’s Northeast government, which directed all its manpower and resources toward defeating its rivals in civil war. The term warlord presupposes that the Northeast government revolved around the personal allegiances and kinship ties of Zhang’s Fengtian clique and its associates.

To finance wars, the Northeast government required merchants to make compulsory donations, and it frequently halted the trade of essential strategic goods in the interest of warfare. The Northeast government operated various provincial banks, issued its own currency, and manipulated the exchange rates of more than ten currencies in circulation. Incessant warfare debilitated the Manchurian economy, causing inflation, interrupting market activity, and diverting revenue from economic development.

zh: 东北政府在与日本达成的军事援助交易中取得了经济与政治上的独立地位。作为分裂与削弱中国的策略，日本支持张作霖的军备建设，同时援助他在中国本部的对手，以把他的权力遏制在满洲之内。除财政援助外，日本帮助张建立兵工厂。1913至1931年，日本还向张及其子的政权派遣十三名日本军事顾问。在帮助张作霖制定战略计划的同时，军事顾问收集其军队的情报。例如，一名1922年协助张对直系作战的顾问，最终出任关东军司令官，并在1931年九一八事变及随后的日本占领中扮演主要角色。但一些可疑的军事顾问为张充当日本政治的情报员，或在完成官方顾问任期后留任他的私人幕僚。
en: The Northeast government acquired its economic and political independence from Japan in exchange for military aid. As a tactic meant to divide and weaken China, Japan supported Zhang Zuolin’s military buildup, while also assisting his rivals in China proper so as to contain his power within Manchuria. In addition to financial assistance, Japan helped Zhang build arms factories. From 1913 to 1931, Japan also sent thirteen Japanese military advisers to the regimes of Zhang and his son. While helping Zhang Zuolin with his strategic plans, the military advisers gathered intelligence on his armies. For instance, one adviser, who assisted Zhang in his war with the Zhili faction in 1922, eventually became the commander in chief in the Kwantung Army and played a major role in the Manchurian Incident in 1931 and the subsequent Japanese occupation. Yet some dubious military advisers worked for Zhang as informants on Japanese politics or remained as his personal aides after completing their official terms as advisers.

zh: 中国商人靠与张作霖及其政府合作而生存。商会（朝鲜语sanghoe，中文shanghui）——商人与企业主的协会——中介个别商人与军阀政府之间的关系。1904至1911年，奉天至少有二十个商会，吉林七个，黑龙江六个。如前所述，商会由各类企业主组成。例如1929年，东边道铁岭县商会包括903家商号，仅举数例：豆腐店、丝绸布庄、粮栈、放债商、当铺、煤店、理发店、医生、烟商、客栈与书商。
商会促进商界利益，为会员提供互助并调解其间纠纷。除这些典型组织功能外，它们还为东北政府履行特定职能。正如罗纳德·苏莱斯基（Ronald Suleski）所写，商会确定流通中几种货币的相对价值。它们定期评估市场状况、商品价格与贸易惯例，并向实业局提交汇编报告。商会还与政府谈判税率与军事特别捐献的数额。

children: 〔校注〕原书作“东边道 Ch'ŏllyŏng 县”。Ch'ŏllyŏng 对应铁岭，但民国时期铁岭县属奉天省辽沈道，不在东边道辖境（东边道辖安东、兴京、通化、临江、辑安、柳河等东南边境诸县），疑原书地名或道属有误。此处照转写译作铁岭，存疑。

en: Chinese merchants survived by cooperating with Zhang Zuolin and his government. Chambers of commerce (sanghoe in Korean and shanghui in Chinese), associations of merchants and business owners, mediated relations between individual merchants and the warlord government. From 1904 to 1911, there were at least twenty chambers of commerce in Fengtian, seven in Jilin, and six in Heilongjiang Provinces. As noted, the chambers of commerce consisted of various types of business owners. For instance, in 1929 the chamber of commerce in Ch’ŏllyŏng county of Tongbyŏndo included 903 businesses, including bean curd shops, silk cloth stores, grain stores, moneylenders, pawnshops, coal shops, hairdressers, doctors, tobacconists, inns, and booksellers to name few.

The chambers of commerce promoted the interests of the business community, providing mutual assistance to its members and mediating disputes among them. Beyond these typical organizational functions, they carried out specific functions for the Northeast government. As Ronald Suleski writes, the chambers of commerce fixed the relative value of the several currencies in circulation. They regularly assessed market conditions, commodity prices, and trade practices and compiled reports for the Bureau of Industry. The chambers of commerce also negotiated with the government over tax rates and the amounts of special contributions for the military.

zh: 张作霖的东北军队1922年被其军事对手击败。这使权力均衡向商人倾斜。商人联合文官，倡导民族主义经济改革。他们迫使张1922年宣布满洲脱离中国本部独立，并与北京的直系签订和约。奉天省新任民政长官成功施压，促使张作霖在奉天分置民政机关和军事机关，这原则上将阻止军队干预行政与经济事务。奉天民政长官号令其他省省长，在满洲行政、财政、农业开发与工业化的全面改革中扮演领导角色。改革给予满洲经济发展前所未有的优先地位，置于战争之上。在新土地登记与税收制度下，奉天政府的储备1923至1924年翻了一番。
为稳定货币，官立银行的管辖权从军队转归财政局。经济发展是改革的另一重要领域。东北政府修建六条以上与南满铁路平行的新铁路。为挑战日本棉纱的支配地位，政府还建新纺织厂并补贴棉业与棉农。
后文将详述，为扩大劳动力而从华北招募农民移民。
en: Zhang Zuolin’s northeastern armies were defeated by his military rivals in 1922. This tilted the balance of power toward the merchants. Allied with civil bureaucrats, they advocated nationalist economic reforms. They forced Zhang to declare the independence of Manchuria from China proper in 1922 and to sign a peace treaty with the Zhili faction in Beijing. A new civil governor of Fengtian Province successfully pressed Zhang to separate the civil and military governments there, which would in principle prevent the military from interfering in administrative and economic matters. Commanding other provincial governors, the civil governor of Fengtian played a leadership role in undertaking comprehensive reforms in administration, finance, agricultural development, and industrialization in Manchuria. The reforms gave unprecedented priority to the economic development of Manchuria, placing it ahead of warfare. Under new land registration and tax systems, the reserves of the Fengtian government doubled from 1923 to 1924.

To stabilize currencies, jurisdiction over official banks passed from the military to the Bureau of Finance. The development of the economy was another important area of reform. The Northeast government constructed more than half a dozen new railways that ran parallel to the South Manchuria Railway. To challenge the domination of Japanese cotton yarn, the government also built new textile mills and subsidized cotton industries and growers.
As will be elaborated later, peasant migrants were recruited from North China to expand the labor force.

zh: 军事当局与经济改革者的联盟是短暂的。张违背承诺，其军队1924年以高于以往的军费重启战争。他再次干预民政，向中国本部的外国银行借款、发行更多货币、增设新税。
后果比上一次经济危机更糟：到1928年，奉天省政府省会奉天市全部商号的三分之一以上被迫停业。满洲文献把军阀与商人资产阶级的合作描述为张恢复实力的策略。由于军阀政府合作程度非同寻常，这次改革成为满洲文献的中心议题。商人领导的反日抗议被认为强化了军阀与资产阶级的二分。1915年，满洲各商会组织广泛运动，呼吁抵制日本货币。
1924与1927年，这些商会还组织示威，反对日本设立领事馆并谴责使用日本货币。总商会门前的一次示威聚集约两万五千人，包括店员、官员、劳动者与学生。
1927年，奉天总商会命令所有其他商会使用东北三省官银号（Dongbeisansheng guanyinhao）发行的货币，并停止使用被日本垄断的港口大连。
en: The alliance of the military authority and economic reformers was brief. Breaking his promise, Zhang’s armies resumed the war in 1924 with military budgets higher than before. Interfering again with civil affairs, he borrowed money from foreign banks in China proper, issued more currency, and added new taxes.

The fallout was worse than the previous economic crisis; by 1928, more than one-third of all businesses in Fengtian City, capital of the Fengtian provincial government, had to close. The literature on Manchuria describes the collaboration of the military and the merchant bourgeoisie as a tactic by Zhang to regain his strength. Because of the unusual level of cooperation by the warlord government, this reform is a central issue in the literature on Manchuria. Anti-Japanese protests led by merchants were seen to bolster the dichotomy between the warlords and the bourgeoisie. In 1915, the chambers of commerce in Manchuria organized widespread movements that called for a boycott of Japanese currency.

In 1924 and 1927, these chambers also organized demonstrations to oppose Japan’s establishment of consulates and to denounce the use of Japanese currency. One demonstration in front of the General Chamber of Commerce assembled about twenty-five thousand people, including store clerks, officials, laborers, and students.

In 1927, the General Chamber of Commerce in Fengtian ordered all the other chambers to use the currencies issued by the Official Bank of the Three Northeastern Provinces (Dongbeisansheng guanyinhao) and stop using Dairen, the port monopolized by Japan.

zh: 史学把军阀统治与日本侵蚀下的满洲经济刻画为半封建半殖民地。据中国近期一部重要著作《东北经济史》（Dongbei jingjishi），军阀的专制权力与殖民干预打断了清代中国商人开启的满洲资本主义发展进程。
农业生产力的提高不是靠改良生产方法，而是靠对耕作者的封建式剥削。赫伯特·比克斯（Herbert Bix）以封建农业与资本主义工商业的二分界定满洲经济，二者受国内地主与殖民资本控制。
欧文·拉铁摩尔（Owen Lattimore）则把满洲经济描述为绝非资本主义：盛行的是裙带关系而非规定的土地分配；拥有农地却居住城市的地主缺乏任何企业家精神，把土地视为财富来源而非资本形式。
en: Historiography characterizes the Manchurian economy under warlord rule and Japanese encroachment as semifeudal and semicolonial. According to a recent major Chinese publication, The Economic History of Northeast China (Dongbei jingjishi), the despotic power of the warlords and colonial intervention thwarted the initial role of the Chinese merchants in commencing the capitalist development of Manchuria in the Qing period.

The productivity of agriculture increased not by improving methods of production but by feudalistic exploitation of cultivators. Herbert Bix defines the Manchurian economy in terms of the bifurcation of feudal agriculture and capitalist commerce and industry under the control of domestic landlords and colonial capital.

Owen Lattimore describes the Manchurian economy as anything but capitalist: nepotism prevailed rather than the dictated distribution of land; and landlords who owned agricultural land but resided in cities lacked any entrepreneurial spirit, considering land a source of wealth rather than a form of capital.

zh: 三角政治
en: Triangular Politics

zh: 张作霖政府与商人的二分——满洲史学的中心建构——抹去了军阀与商人资产阶级都追求资本主义发展的事实。把张作霖政府与日本权力混同，则遮蔽了他们与中国商人的复杂关系。加文·麦考马克（Gavan McCormack）在论及张同时与日本及商人妥协时说，他“不止是一个日本傀儡，但算不上一个民族主义者”。
这一富有洞见的观察可以通过关注东北政府的经济基础而深化。尽管军阀一词排除了承认其资本主义性质的可能，张、其家族及其行政班子却是经济各部门——从农业、商业到金融机构——的主要投资者。史学很少承认军阀及其政权所拥有的资产类型。即使注意到军阀政府的资本，也只是把它与被视为资本主义的私营农业公司相比。
en: The dichotomy of the Zhang Zuolin government and the merchants, a central construct of Manchurian historiography, elides the fact that both the warlords and the merchant bourgeoisie pursued capitalist development. The conflation of the Zhang Zuolin government with Japanese power obscures their complex relationship with Chinese merchants. Addressing Zhang’s simultaneous compromise with Japan and the merchants, Gavan McCormack states that he was “more than a mere Japanese puppet but less than a nationalist.”

This insightful observation can be deepened by paying attention to the economic basis of the Northeast government. Although the term warlord precludes acknowledging its capitalist character, Zhang, his family, and his administration were major investors in all sectors of the economy, from agriculture and commerce to financial institutions. It is rare for historiography to recognize the types of assets owned by warlords and their regimes. Even when a warlord government’s capital is noted, it is compared to private agricultural companies, which are considered capitalist.

zh: 东北政府的物质基础揭示了它与商人资产阶级联盟的结构框架。军阀及其家族是最大的地主，因为他们积累了大量土地。张作霖利用权力把土地授予同伙及其家族。他还以东北军的名义积累土地。
此外，省政府投资土地，因为农业是商业与新兴工厂的基础——这些工厂加工农产品，制造豆油、面粉、丝织物与棉纱等。官方投资的主要形式是经营土地公司。土地公司创立于1900年代初，1920年有137家官办土地公司（奉天71家、吉林51家、黑龙江15家）。除招募佃农与劳动者外，土地公司承诺通过研究新作物与耕作技术并传授给农民来增加农业产出。除其宣称的目标外，据说土地公司还协助军阀政府取得土地与提高地租。
en: The material basis of the Northeast government reveals the structural framework of its alliance with the merchant bourgeoisie. The warlords and their families were the largest landlords, as they had amassed vast amounts of land. Zhang Zuolin exploited his power to grant land to his associates and their families. He also amassed land under the name of the Northeast Army.

Furthermore, the provincial governments invested in land, since agriculture was the basis of commerce and the emergent factories that processed agricultural products such as bean oil, flour, and silk and cotton yarn. A chief form of official investment was the operation of land companies. Established in the early 1900s, there were 137 official land companies in 1920 (71 in Fengtian, 51 in Jilin, and 15 in Heilongjiang). In addition to recruiting tenants and laborers, land companies pledged to increase agricultural output by conducting research on new crops and techniques of cultivation and teaching them to the peasants. Apart from their stated objectives, land companies were said to assist the warlord government in acquiring land and increasing rents.

zh: 张作霖领导下的省政府——经常与商人资产阶级合伙——在满洲各地设立自己的银行与其他金融组织。奉天官银号（Fengtian guanyinhao）1905年开设于沈阳，1924年改名东北三省官银号，在满洲有二十二家分行与十二家支分行。它投资于各部门。其总投资的一半投向经营大豆、大米与其他谷物的商号，七分之一投向当铺——当铺与货币兑换店一起构成最初级但使用最广的金融组织类型。官银号经营的货币兑换店通过兑换各种货币、出售豆油与其他商品获利。
省官银号与官银号的贷款使经营称为粮栈（liangchan）的谷物批发商号的商人，得以向农忙季节缺钱的农民放贷，条件是农民预先约定把收成卖给粮栈。由于缺乏足够抵押的农民无法获得银行贷款，他们常以即将到来的秋收作为贷款担保。农民违约时，放贷者夺取其收获。通过这种做法，银行与粮栈在农产品市价最低点时提前锁定了收购作物的价格。
en: The provincial governments under Zhang Zuolin’s leadership, often in partnership with the merchant bourgeoisie, established their own banks and other financial organizations throughout Manchuria. The Fengtian Official Bank (Fengtian guanyinhao), which opened in Shenyang in 1905 and was renamed the Official Bank of the Three Northeastern Provinces in 1924, had twenty-two branches and twelve subbranches in Manchuria. It invested in various sectors. Half of its total investment was in stores that traded soybeans, rice, and other grains, and one-seventh was in pawnshops, which, together with money-exchange stores, constituted the most rudimentary but widely used type of financial organization. Money-exchange stores run by the Official Bank earned profits by exchanging various currencies and selling bean oil and other merchandise.

The loans from official banks of provinces and the Official Bank enabled merchants who ran wholesale grain stores, called liangchan, to finance farmers who needed money during the agricultural season in return for a prearranged sale of their harvest. As bank loans were inaccessible to peasants who lacked sufficient collateral, they often put up their coming autumn harvest as security for their loans. When farmers defaulted on their loans, the lenders seized their harvests. With this practice, the banks and liangchan set the future price of crops when market prices for agricultural products were at their lowest point.

zh: 承认军阀权力的物质基础及其与商人资产阶级的合伙关系，使我们对1922至1925年实行的短暂经济改革获得新解释。它强调改革是一个结构性事件。作为经济关键部门的主要投资者，军部在发展满洲经济——包括促进与日本竞争的本国产业——上有既得利益。因此，持续战争与经济发展之间的张力标志着军部内部的矛盾，而不仅是军部与商人之间的冲突。
en: Recognizing the material basis of warlord power and its partnership with the merchant bourgeoisie allows a new interpretation of the short-lived economic reform in effect from 1922 to 1925. It underscores the fact that the reform was a structural event. As the main investor in key sectors of the economy, the military had a vested interest in developing Manchuria’s economy, including the promotion of national industries in competition with the Japanese. The tension between persistent warfare and economic development therefore signified an internal contradiction within the military, not just a conflict between the military and the merchants.

zh: 日本与商人资产阶级之间的含混关系构成了三角关系的第三条边。奉天省日中资产阶级之间的合资企业早于1915年条约，尽管其后扩张。
尽管目标与目的不同，他们共享把满洲从中国本部分离、阻止张军备建设的目标。商人资产阶级支持反对张作霖的运动，该运动在吉林远强于其他两省。尽管商人资产阶级起源于中国本部，它却支持吉林独立运动，围绕其地区身份集结，呼吁由本地区人民治理本省。
当张1924年重启战争时，商人资产阶级发现日本提出同样要求：张撤军。张通过使商人资产阶级与日本相互对立而化解他们的威胁。他承诺镇压反日示威，以此与日本讨价还价换取军事援助。同时，他支持1920年代末兴起、旨在废除1915年条约的收回利权运动（Recovery Movement）。日本与张作霖及商人之间起伏不定的关系持续到1929年张学良与国民党组成抗日阵线。
en: The ambiguous relationship between Japan and the merchant bourgeoisie completed the triangle of relationships. Joint ventures between Japan and the Chinese bourgeoisie in Fengtian Province predated the 1915 Treaty, although they expanded afterward.

Despite their differing goals and purposes, they shared the goal of separating Manchuria from China proper and halting Zhang’s military buildup. The merchant bourgeoisie supported the movement opposed to Zhang Zuolin, which was far stronger in Jilin than in the two other provinces. Even though the merchant bourgeoisie originated in China proper, it supported the Jilin independence movement, rallying around its regional identity and calling for rule of the province by the people of the region.

When Zhang resumed the war in 1924, the merchant bourgeoisie found Japan making the same demand that Zhang withdraw his forces. Zhang deflected the threats from the merchant bourgeoisie and Japan by turning them against each other. Promising to suppress anti-Japanese demonstrations, he bargained with Japan for military aid. Simultaneously, he supported the Recovery Movement, which emerged in the late 1920s to nullify the 1915 Treaty. The fluctuating relations between Japan and Zhang Zuolin and the merchants continued until Zhang Xueliang formed an anti-Japanese front with the Kuomintang in 1929.

zh: 1920年代后反日情绪的高涨，促使在满日本投资者与侨民要求日本政府干预。但日本把满洲从中国本部分离的企图，超出了保护其在满经济利益的直接目标。从1910年代到1931年，满洲独立一直是关东军最终占领全中国的持续策略。其第一次尝试在1912年，即民国政府取代清朝之时。关东军支持前皇室成员及其追随者在满洲与蒙古建立分离政权的流产尝试。1915年条约后反日抗议增加时，关东厅与关东军协助了类似的徒劳倡议。当时日本各派在支持前皇室成员与张作霖之间分裂。东京内阁听从其在满领事的建议，支持张作霖。然而，在东京军部与皇室的支持下，关东军支持前清政府的追随者——他们不久即被张平定。1931年，日军终于成功分离满洲：它占领那里的主要城市，据称是为了保护南满铁路。
en: The surge of anti-Japanese sentiment after the 1920s provoked Japanese investors and residents of Manchuria to demand that the Japanese government intervene. Yet Japan’s attempt to separate Manchuria from China proper surpassed its immediate goal of protecting its economic interests in Manchuria. From the 1910s to 1931, the independence of Manchuria remained the Kwantung Army’s persistent strategy for the eventual occupation of all of China. Its first attempt took place in 1912, when the Republican government replaced the Qing. The Kwantung Army supported an abortive attempt by former imperial members and followers to establish a separate regime in Manchuria and Mongolia. When anti-Japanese protests increased in the aftermath of the 1915 Treaty, the Kwantung Administration and Kwantung Army assisted in a similar futile initiative. At that time, Japanese factions were split between supporting the former imperial members and Zhang Zuolin. Following the recommendation of its consuls in Manchuria, the Tokyo Cabinet supported Zhang Zuolin. However, with support from the military and the imperial family in Tokyo, the Kwantung Army backed the followers of the former Qing government, who were soon pacified by Zhang. In 1931, the Japanese military finally succeeded in separating Manchuria when it occupied major cities there, allegedly to protect the South Manchuria Railway.

zh: 三角关系更多是权力的动态平衡而非僵局。在追求领土与资本主义利益中，三方时而结盟，时而发生争端。政治关系的这种三角形状要求修正民族与殖民政治的分析。第一，三角政治把民族与殖民政治锚定于社会领域。权力均衡把不相容的领土政治转化为相互竞争的形态。日本以保护朝鲜人及其资产为名，通过资助朝鲜移民与扩张军队，诉诸渐进殖民的渗透策略。为对抗日本策略，东北政府不仅试图把朝鲜人逐出满洲，还试图巩固对中国移民及其财产的主权。只关注军事扩张与经济不稳定，会把日本帝国或中国民族的形成与民族主体的构建及其社会经验割裂开来。
en: The triangular relationship was more a dynamic balancing of power than a stalemate. In the pursuit of territorial and capitalist interests, the three parties entered into partnerships and disputes. This triangular shape of political relations gives rise to revisions of the analysis of national and colonial politics. First, the triangular politics anchored national and colonial politics in the social sphere. The balance of power translated incompatible territorial politics into the competing formations. Japan resorted to the osmotic strategy of gradual colonization by financing Korean migration and expanding its military forces in the name of protecting Koreans and their assets. To counter the Japanese strategy, the Northeast government tried not only to evict Koreans from Manchuria but also to consolidate its sovereignty over Chinese migrants and their property. An exclusive focus on military expansion and economic instability dissociates the formation of the Japanese empire or the Chinese nation from the construction of national subjects and their social experiences.

zh: 第二，三角政治要求关注民族与殖民力量内部的矛盾，以及它们之间的复杂关系。国际矛盾使每种力量的主权都只是部分的。日本渗透政治受困于内在困境：其各行政机构在争夺权力时对如何处置在满朝鲜人争执不休。中国民族形成也遇到障碍，不仅因为商人与东北政府关系不稳定，也因为该政府矛盾的领土与资本主义抱负。例如，东北政府一面执行国籍法，一面在实践中退让，因为驱逐朝鲜人会阻碍该地区的资本主义发展。
en: Second, the triangular politics demands attention to internal contradictions within national and colonial forces, as well as the complex relationships among them. The international contradiction rendered each force’s sovereignty as only partial. Japanese osmotic politics was hampered by the inherent dilemma that arose when its administrative agents disputed their policies toward Koreans in the competition for power. Chinese nation formation also encountered hurdles, not just because of unstable relations between merchants and the Northeast government but also because of that government’s contradictory territorial and capitalist aspirations. For instance, the Northeast government simultaneously enforced and retreated from the nationality law, as the eviction of Koreans would impede capitalist development of the region.

zh: 这些修正要求对农民的社会经验采取新视角。满洲传统史学以熟悉的剥削、债务、贫困与流离循环来表象农民经验。它把社会分化为地主与农民认定为封建与殖民剥削的产物。它使用单一的农民范畴而不区分其国籍为中国人或朝鲜人，或许因为朝鲜人占总人口不足5%。然而即使历史学家聚焦在满朝鲜人的具体经验，其记述仍类似于对农民贫困化更一般的描述。

这种现有进路遮蔽了农民社会经验沿族群与民族界线的碎片化，而这种碎片化又决定了对土地与资本的获取。中朝农民的不平等产生于民族与殖民力量的政治——它们争夺对土地与人民的主权。与通常假设的同质经验相反，中朝农民被纳入不同的资本网络——中国的与日本的。他们也属于不同的社会空间。朝鲜农民被限制为短期佃农与廉价农业劳动者，而中国农民被转化为土地所有者。朝鲜与中国农民分别被塑造成日本与中国的民族主体，这一过程在 1915 年条约划定的框架内发生。
en: These revisions warrant a new perspective on the social experience of peasants. The conventional historiography of Manchuria represents the peasant experience in terms of the familiar cycle of exploitation, debt, poverty, and displacement. It identifies the polarization of society into landlords and peasants as a product of feudal and colonial exploitation. It employs a unitary category of peasants without differentiating their nationality as Chinese or Koreans, perhaps because Koreans comprised less than 5 percent of the total population. Yet even when historians focus on the specific experiences of Koreans of Manchuria their accounts resemble the more general descriptions of peasant impoverishment.

This existing approach obscures the fragmentation of the peasant social experience along ethnic and national lines, which in turn determined access to land and capital. The inequality of Chinese and Korean peasants emerged from the politics of the national and colonial forces, which competed for sovereignty over land and people. Contrary to the commonly assumed homogeneous experience, Chinese and Korean peasants were incorporated into different networks of capital—Chinese and Japanese. They also belonged to disparate social spaces. Korean peasants were restricted to being short-term tenants and cheap agricultural laborers, while Chinese peasants were transformed into landowners. The production of both Korean and Chinese peasants—as national subjects of Japan and China, respectively—took place within the parameters set by the 1915 Treaty.

zh: 财产权与治外法权：1915年条约
en: property rights and extraterritoriality: the 1915 treaty

zh: 1915年《南满洲及东部内蒙古条约》为直到1931年日本与中国东北政府之间的争端划定了范围。该条约是日本向中国提出的所谓“二十一条”激烈谈判的结果。谈判涉及1915年1月至5月间的二十五次会议与数次修订。尽管历史学家惯例聚焦于辽东半岛与铁路租借延期的争端，其他被激烈争执的问题是日本臣民的财产权与治外法权。
这一时期北京与东北省政府之间的秘密电报揭示了围绕这些问题激烈谈判的过程。
en: The Treaty on South Manchuria and East Inner Mongolia of 1915 set parameters for the disputes between Japan and the Northeast government of China until 1931. The treaty was the outcome of fierce negotiations over the so-called Twenty-one Demands that Japan presented to China. The negotiations involved twenty-five meetings and several revisions between January and May of 1915. Although historians have routinely focused on the disputes over the extension of the leasing of the Liaodong Peninsula and railways, other intensely disputed issues were the property rights and extraterritoriality of Japanese subjects.
Secret telegrams between Beijing and the Northeast provincial government during this period reveal the processes of intense negotiation over these issues.

zh: 在“二十一条”谈判期间，日本起初试图确保其臣民的土地所有权，继而退而要求取得“购买”土地的权利，最终满足于“租借”土地的权利。中国中央政府反对允许日本臣民购买土地。这是因为购买一词暗示买者对土地的事实所有权。然而，就租借土地权利（朝鲜语sangjo，中文shangzu，商租）达成的解决，绝非对所有权问题的明确解决。契约的无条件续约使租借与所有权难以充分区分。
en: During negotiations over its Twenty-one Demands, Japan at first attempted to ensure land ownership of its subjects, then conceded the right to “purchase” land, and finally settled for the right to “lease” land. The Chinese central government objected to allowing Japanese subjects to purchase land. This was because the term purchase suggested the buyer’s de facto ownership of the land. The settlement on the right to lease land (sangjo in Korean, shangzu in Chinese) was, however, anything but a clear resolution of the question of ownership. The unconditional renewal of a contract rendered leasing insufficiently distinguishable from ownership.

zh: 1915年条约签订后，围绕商租的争端涉及三个问题：其定义、适用地理范围、以及适用人群。
各方提出自己对商租的定义，各自依据条约第二条附加说明中的不同措辞：“契约期限以三十年为上限，而契约可以无条件续订。”对民国政府而言，商租授予使用所租土地的权利，排除承租人的所有权；它指临时租借，承租人有权使用他人财产但无权转租土地。对日本而言，商租意味着永久租借、契约无条件连续续约，并赋予承租人在租期内出售所租土地的权利。
此外，日本坚持商租应实施于南满与内蒙古的部分地区。作为回应，张作霖1923年发布法令，把商租仅适用于奉天省部分地区。
朝鲜人租地权是另一争议问题，因为中国不承认朝鲜人为日本臣民。
en: After signing the 1915 Treaty, the disputes over sangjo entailed three issues: its definition, the geographic area of its application, and the people subject to it.

Voicing its own definition of sangjo, each party relied on a different phrase in the attached explanation of Article 2 of the treaty: “The duration of the contract is limited to a maximum period of thirty years, while the renewal of the contract is permitted without conditions.” To the Republican government, sangjo granted the right to use the leased land, which ruled out ownership by the lessee, and it referred to temporary leasing, which entitled the lessee to use someone else’s property without the right to sublease the land. To Japan, sangjo meant permanent leasing with unconditional and continuous renewals of contract, and it would endow the lessee with the right to sell the leased land during the lease period.

Moreover, Japan insisted that sangjo be implemented in parts of South Manchuria and Inner Mongolia. In response, Zhang Zuolin issued a decree in 1923 that applied sangjo only to some parts of Fengtian Province.
The right of Koreans to lease land was another disputed issue, since China did not acknowledge Koreans as Japanese subjects.

zh: 租地争端中更深的关切是日本的渗透政治——它把获得土地所有权与占领领土想象为同构的过程。一位中国知识分子1931年把商租认定为日本领土渗透的主要机制：
en: A deeper concern in the disputes over leasing land was Japan’s osmotic politics, which imagined the homology of landownership and territorial occupation. A Chinese intellectual in 1931 identified sangjo as a principal mechanism of Japan’s territorial osmosis:

children: 商租是日本得以在大陆确立主权的经典策略。这一方法使日本能够把领土侵略变为相对和平而渐进的过程。日本起初逐步取得土地。然后援引日本领事馆对涉日案件的司法裁判权，试图在日本臣民居住地区非法设立警察署。接着日本把该地区“日本化”，变为日本领土。这一过程如同病毒侵入身体：先渗透肝脏，再逐步接管身体各部分。
此处肝脏的感染象征日本对土地的取得——它不仅为地主营利奠定基础，也为渐进殖民满洲奠定基础。

Sangjo is a classic strategy with which Japan can establish its sovereignty on a continent. This method will enable Japan to make territorial invasion a relatively peaceful and gradual process. Japan at first gradually acquires land. Then it attempts illegally to establish police stations in the areas where Japanese subjects reside, citing the judicial right of Japanese consulates to rule in court cases involving Japanese. Then Japan “Japanizes” the areas, turning them into Japanese territory. This process works the way a virus infiltrates a body, first penetrating the liver, then gradually taking over all parts of the body.
Here the infection of the liver symbolizes Japanese acquisition of land, which laid the basis not just for profit making by landowners but also for the gradual colonization of Manchuria.

zh: 当日本臣民租地权与其治外法权结合时，商租便意味着日本的领土主权。承租人的治外法权意味着，除非租借条款与所有权条款明确分离，日本领事馆可对承租人乃至所租土地本身持有主权。若租地面积扩大，日本主权也随之扩大。1915年条约在允许日本臣民治外法权却未明确定义租借时，为这种可能性敞开了大门。签订1915年条约前，日本起初要求日本臣民的全面治外法权：其臣民向日本政府纳税，其领事裁判一切涉日被告的民事纠纷，中日共同裁决中日土地权利人之间的土地争端案件。
en: When the right of Japanese subjects to lease land was combined with their extraterritoriality, sangjo signified Japan’s territorial sovereignty. Extraterritoriality of the lessee meant that Japanese consulates could hold sovereignty over both the lessee and the leased land itself unless the terms of the lease were clearly divorced from that of landownership. If the area of leased land were to increase, so would Japanese sovereignty. The 1915 Treaty left the door wide open to this possibility when it permitted extraterritoriality for Japanese subjects without a clear definition of leasing. Before signing the 1915 Treaty, Japan first demanded comprehensive extraterritoriality of Japanese subjects: its subjects would pay taxes to the Japanese government, its consuls would adjudicate all civil disputes involving Japanese defendants, and Japan and China would collectively rule on cases concerning land disputes between Chinese and Japanese landowners.

zh: 民国政府提出两个替代方案：日本臣民服从中国法律、向中国政府纳税，土地争端由中国法院独家审理。用中国外交总长的话说：“日本寻求侵犯我国主权，要求日本臣民居住、贸易、务农的自由，尤其要求土地所有权……若希望其臣民居住满洲并拥有或租借我国土地，日本必须撤回由日本领事裁判涉日案件的要求。”
最终双方各作妥协。1915年条约要求日本臣民遵守中国法律、向中国政府纳税，而日本领事主持一切涉日案件，但土地争端案件除外——后者由中日共同裁决。当中国政府缺乏唯一权威起诉土地契约违法者时，其对土地及其占有者主权的丧失就等于领土主权的丧失。
en: The Republican government proposed two alternatives: Japanese subjects would submit to Chinese laws and pay taxes to the Chinese government and Chinese courts would have sole authority over land disputes. In the words of the head of the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs: “Japan seeks to infringe upon our sovereignty, demanding freedom in residence, trade, agriculture, and particularly landownership by Japanese subjects. . . . If it wishes its subjects to reside in Manchuria and own or lease our land, Japan must withdraw its demand that Japanese consuls decide the court cases involving Japanese.”

In the end, each side compromised. The 1915 Treaty required Japanese subjects to observe Chinese laws and pay taxes to the Chinese government, while Japanese consuls would preside over all Japanese court cases except those involving land disputes, which were to be ruled on collectively by both Japan and China. When it lacked the sole authority to prosecute violators of the laws on land contracts, the Chinese government’s loss of sovereignty over land and its occupants would be equal to its loss of territorial sovereignty.

zh: 条约签订后，围绕土地所有权与治外法权的持续争端，后来延伸到反对中外不平等条约的政治抗议以外。为废除条约，北京政府官员在1919年巴黎与1921年纽约的国际会议期间诉诸国际社会。事实上，中国国会1923年宣布条约无效，尽管没有任何实际效果。土地所有权与治外法权问题并未激起与反对租借铁路及辽东半岛的反日抗议相关的强烈公众抗议。相反，租地与治外法权问题在社会空间中被争夺。政府对土地交易社会实践的规制成为中国民族形成的基石。例如，民国政府颁布《国籍惩罚条例》（Kukchŏk chingbŏl chore），以这类契约侵犯中国领土主权为由，判处向外国人交易土地者死刑。
en: After the treaty was signed, the continued disputes over landownership and extraterritoriality developed beyond the familiar spectacle of political protests against unequal treaties between China and foreign powers. In order to nullify the treaty, Beijing government officials appealed to the international community during international conferences in Paris in 1919 and New York in 1921. In fact, the Chinese Congress invalidated the treaty in 1923, though without any tangible effects. The issues of landownership and extraterritoriality did not incite the intense public outcry associated with anti-Japanese protests against the leasing of railways and the Liaodong Peninsula. Instead the issues of leasing land and extraterritoriality were contested in the social space. Government regulation of the social practices of land transactions became the bedrock of Chinese nation formation. The Republican government, for instance, enacted the National Punishment Law (Kukchŏk chingbŏl chore), which sentenced to death those who traded land to foreigners on the grounds that such contracts would violate the territorial sovereignty of China.

zh: 土地交易的社会规制主要发生在满洲。张统治下的东北政府以中国政府自居，把中国移民转化为国民，与日本“他者”对立。日本努力把朝鲜移民转化为日本臣民。对日本与东北政府而言，与人民的新关系不仅涉及政治规训，如惩罚违反国籍法与政策者。它还通过向农民提供社会计划，确立日本和东北政府各自对农民的民族霸权。民族主体的社会生产承诺缓解移民——无论朝鲜人还是中国人——之间政治、经济与文化的差异与不平等。
en: The social regulation of land transactions mainly took place in Manchuria. Representing itself as the Chinese national government, the Northeast government under Zhang’s rule transformed Chinese migrants into nationals as opposed to Japanese “others.” Japan endeavored to convert Korean migrants into Japanese subjects. For both Japan and the Northeast government, the new relationship with the people not only involved political discipline such as the punishment of those who violated nationality laws and policies. It also constituted the national hegemony of the former over peasants by providing them with social programs. The social production of national subjects promised to mitigate political, economic, and cultural differences and inequality among migrants, whether Korean or Chinese.

zh: 实践渗透政治
en: practicing osmotic politics

zh: 1920年代日本渗透政治取决于农场与领事馆的运作。两项措施都旨在把朝鲜耕作者变为日本臣民，同时平息流亡朝鲜人发起的政治运动。朝鲜人耕种农田的扩大预期把更多土地置于日本控制之下；同时，领事馆将以保护朝鲜人为名扩充日本军警力量。这种渗透政治面临外部与内部双重障碍。面对中国中央与东北政府的反对，日本既未确保日本臣民租地权——更谈不上所有权——也未如愿增加领事馆数量。此外，日本文官行政官之间的不和与界定不清的等级，妨碍他们有效管理朝鲜人定居与遏制朝鲜人反抗。由于东京内阁由文官官僚领导——他们承诺1918至1931年放弃对满洲的军事干预——关东军并不主持渗透政治。
en: Japanese osmotic politics in the 1920s hinged on the operation of agricultural farms and consulates. Both measures were intended to make Korean cultivators into Japanese subjects while pacifying the exiled Korean movement. The expansion of farmland cultivated by Koreans was expected to bring more land under Japan’s control; at the same time, consulates would augment Japanese military and police forces in the name of protecting Koreans. This osmotic politics faced both external and internal hurdles. Facing objections from the central and Northeast governments of China, Japan neither ensured the right of Japanese subjects to lease land, let alone own it, nor increased the number of consulates by as many as it had wished. Moreover, the dissension and ill-defined hierarchy among civilian Japanese administrators hampered their effective management of Korean settlement and the containment of Korean opposition. Since the Tokyo Cabinet was led by civil bureaucrats, who had pledged to forgo military intervention in Manchuria from 1918 until 1931, the Kwantung Army did not preside over the osmotic politics.

zh: “保护”朝鲜人
en: “Protecting” Koreans

zh: 1920年代中期在满朝鲜人约一百万。至少四分之一的在满朝鲜人住在奉天省，当地的移民潮可追溯到十九世纪末——东北政府的基地及其与日本争夺的主要场所。日本把水稻种植视为稳定朝鲜移民家庭经济的主要手段，这些移民被债务与频繁迁移所束缚。
据日本报告，南满大多数朝鲜人穷得连耕种用的秧苗都买不起。他们常以收获份额为担保，为几乎每一项必需品——包括土地、住房、粮食与农具——借贷。这些朝鲜人通常把收获的大米换为小米与玉米自用。即使丰年，他们也勉强还清债务、难以养家。歉收迫使他们变卖包括衣物在内的财物，然后迁往新地方。
en: Koreans in Manchuria numbered about one million in the mid-1920s. Dating back to an influx during the late nineteenth century, at least one-fourth of Manchuria’s total Korean population resided in Fengtian Province, which was the base of the Northeast government and the main site of its contention with Japan. Japan regarded rice cultivation as the primary means of stabilizing the household economies of Korean migrants, who were held in thrall to debt and frequent migration.

According to Japanese reports, the majority of Koreans in southern Manchuria were too poor to buy even the seedlings for farming. They often used their share of the harvest as security to take out loans for almost every essential, including land, housing, grain, and farming tools. These Koreans usually traded the rice they harvested for millet and corn for their own consumption. Even in years with good harvests, they barely repaid their debts and had difficulty supporting their families. Bad harvests forced them to sell their possessions, including their clothing, before migrating to a new place.

zh: 日本宣称其渗透策略可以将朝鲜移民变为日本臣民。它把朝鲜人分成所谓“良民”和“不良分子”，援引其保护可信朝鲜人免受朝鲜叛乱者与中国官员压迫的义务。保护朝鲜“良民”、镇压反叛者的政策（Pohoch'wich'e，保护取缔）指把朝鲜人转化为日本臣民的两个构成要素。一方面，保护朝鲜“良民”对应日本权力渗透扩张的第一阶段，因为保护不仅要求把他们与叛乱者、土匪物理隔离，还要求改善其生计。只有稳定其家庭经济，才能打消他们对流亡朝鲜独立运动的支持。朝鲜人家庭经济的改善需要耕种肥沃土地。这一任务由殖民拓殖会社、亲日朝鲜人团体与朝鲜人信用组合协调——它们为朝鲜人购买或租借土地，并承诺引入新农业生产方法、满足教育与卫生的基本需求。这些经济与社会措施预期把朝鲜移民绑定于日本。另一方面，平定顽抗朝鲜人将确保渗透扩张的另一阶段，因为它会加强日本对朝鲜人的主权并增强其军事存在。换言之，渗透政治的推进要求两项措施——改善朝鲜人社会生活与镇压朝鲜叛乱者——同时推进。这是因为日本帝国的渗透扩张要求日本主权施于所有朝鲜人、其农田及其居住地区。
en: Japan represented its osmotic strategy as a way to turn Korean migrants into Japanese subjects. It separated good Koreans from undesirable ones, citing its obligation to protect trustworthy Koreans from oppression by Korean rebels and Chinese officials. The policy of protecting good Koreans and repressing rebellious ones (Pohoch’wich’e) denotes two constitutive elements of transforming Koreans into Japanese subjects. On the one hand, the protection of good Koreans corresponded to the first stage of the osmotic expansion of Japanese power because protection would require not merely their physical segregation from rebels and bandits but the improvement of their livelihood. Only stabilization of their household economies would discourage their support for the exiled Korean independence movement. Improvement of the Korean household economies necessitated the cultivation of fertile land. This task was coordinated by the colonial development companies, pro-Japanese Korean associations, and Korean credit unions, which purchased or leased land for Koreans and pledged to introduce new methods of agricultural production and meet basic needs for education and health. These economic and social measures were expected to bind Korean migrants to Japan. On the other hand, the pacification of recalcitrant Koreans would ensure another stage of osmotic expansion since it would bolster Japanese sovereignty over Koreans and enhance their military presence. In other words, the advancement of osmotic politics required that the two measures—the improvement of Korean social life and the suppression of Korean rebels—progress simultaneously. This was because the osmotic expansion of the Japanese empire required that Japanese sovereignty be wielded over all Koreans, their farmland, and the areas they inhabited.

zh: 东北政府的入籍政策在两项措施之间引入张力。政府反对日本臣民租地，只授予中国国民所有权。它还限制朝鲜人入籍为中国国民。没有朝鲜人入籍，领土渗透的第一幕——日本臣民取得土地——就不可能。尽管入籍会为日本权力的渗透扩张提供必要条件，它却会把朝鲜人与日本分离，从而使其保护朝鲜人的主张落空。无论允许还是阻止朝鲜人入籍，单独采取任一进路都会削弱渗透扩张。日本保护朝鲜“良民”的承诺（通过提供土地）与其对朝鲜人主权的追求相冲突，危及日本权力的渗透扩张。
en: The Northeast government’s policies of naturalization introduced tension between the two measures. The government opposed the leasing of land by Japanese subjects and granted rights to ownership only to Chinese nationals. It also constrained Koreans from becoming naturalized as Chinese nationals. Without the naturalization of Koreans, the first act of territorial osmosis—the acquisition of land by Japanese subjects—would not be possible. Although naturalization would provide a necessary condition for the osmotic expansion of Japanese power, it would separate Koreans from Japan and thus obviate its claim to protect Koreans. Whether permitting or preventing Korean naturalization, the adoption of either approach alone would debilitate osmotic expansion. Japan’s promise to protect good Koreans (through the provision of land) collided with its pursuit of sovereignty over them, jeopardizing the osmotic expansion of Japanese power.

zh: 这一困境从未解决，因为日本各权力在整个1920年代争论朝鲜人的日本国籍，即“帝国国籍”（cheguk kukchŏk）。1920年代关东军权力衰落时，争论主要涉及朝鲜总督府与日本外务省派驻人员。1923年11月，朝鲜总督府在汉城主持首次关于在满朝鲜人问题的全面会议，邀请日本外务省东亚局局长与十名在满日本领事。
流亡朝鲜抵抗集中之地间岛的总领事，反对朝鲜人入籍为中国国民，理由是这会剥夺日本镇压朝鲜独立运动的权利。其作为中国国民的法律身份将使反日朝鲜人免遭日本镇压。它还会把满洲变为顽抗朝鲜人的避风港，因为中国政府不会与日本合作镇压朝鲜抵抗。
en: This dilemma was never resolved, as Japanese powers debated throughout the 1920s the Japanese nationality of Koreans, or “imperial nationality” (cheguk kukchŏk). When the power of the Kwantung Army waned in the 1920s, the debates involved mainly the Government General of Korea and agents of the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs. In November 1923, in Seoul, the Government General of Korea hosted the first comprehensive meeting on the issue of the Koreans of Manchuria, inviting the director of the East Asian Department of the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs and ten Japanese consuls of Manchuria.

The consul general of Kando, where the exiled Korean resistance was concentrated, opposed the naturalization of Koreans as Chinese nationals on the grounds that it would divest Japan of the right to suppress the Korean independence movement. Their legal identity as Chinese nationals would shelter anti-Japanese Koreans from Japanese pacification. It would also turn Manchuria into a haven for defiant Koreans because the Chinese government would not cooperate with Japan to repress Korean resistance.

zh: 相反，奉天总领事——满洲首席领事——提议允许南满朝鲜人入籍。间岛总领事反对入籍主要出于对当地朝鲜政治的关切，而奉天总领事则把南满与蒙古视为日本帝国扩张的基地。对后者而言，间岛与南满情况不同。在间岛，朝鲜人入籍并非必要，因为《间岛协约》保障未入籍朝鲜人的土地所有权（见第三章）。但在南满，即使日本把朝鲜人视为其臣民，除非中国政府——满洲的主权权力——同意接受日本对朝鲜人的主权，这也不会实质影响朝鲜抵抗运动。奉天总领事偏好以对华外交谈判扩张日本在满势力。
最终，1923年领事会议决定反对朝鲜人入籍。一年后奉天总领事重提其提案，却遭朝鲜总督府否决。总督府主要忙于巩固其对朝鲜民族的主权、消除朝鲜叛乱者的威胁。1928年，类似争论重申了日本关于朝鲜人入籍的政策。
en: In contrast, the consul general of Fengtian—the head consul of Manchuria—proposed to permit Korean naturalization in South Manchuria. Although the consul general of Kando opposed naturalization primarily because of his concern over Korean politics there, the consul general of Fengtian considered South Manchuria and Mongolia to be the base of the Japanese empire’s expansion. For the latter, situations in Kando and South Manchuria were different. In Kando, the naturalization of Koreans would not be necessary, since the Kando Treaty guaranteed landownership to nonnaturalized Koreans (see chapter 3). But in South Manchuria, even if Japan were to treat Koreans as its subjects, this would not substantively affect the Korean resistance movement unless the Chinese government—the sovereign power of Manchuria—agreed to accept Japan’s sovereignty over Koreans. The consul general of Fengtian favored diplomatic negotiation with China in expanding Japanese influence in Manchuria.

In the end, the consul meeting of 1923 decided to oppose Korean naturalization. One year later the consul general of Fengtian reissued his proposal only to be rejected by the Government General of Korea. The government general was mainly preoccupied with consolidating its sovereignty over the Korean nation and eliminating the threats from Korean rebels. In 1928, similar debates reaffirmed Japan’s policy on Korean naturalization.

zh: 原则上，这一日本政策会阻碍朝鲜人取得土地，从而阻碍渗透扩张的第一阶段。实际上，日本试图把这一政策反转为同时保障朝鲜人土地所有权与日本对朝鲜人主权的替代策略。1923年决定拒绝朝鲜人入籍后，日本聚焦于使已入籍朝鲜人的中国国籍无效，而非阻止朝鲜人入籍。同时，日本行政官设想利用已入籍朝鲜人购买土地。日本使朝鲜人入籍无效的做法源于中华民国政府的国籍法——该法要求外国人取得本国政府许可方可入籍为中国国民。
日本的这一做法赋予已入籍朝鲜人双重国籍：既是中国国民又是日本臣民。朝鲜总督府驻哈尔滨领事馆（位于黑龙江省中部，即所谓北满）的一名官员在谈到把朝鲜人双重国籍作为日本权力渗透扩张工具时说：“朝鲜人的双重国籍目前对日本有利，因为它有助于巩固日本的经济与领土利益。日本可以为已入籍的朝鲜人移居北满提供便利，并向他们提供购地的财政援助；若中国当局抗议这一做法，日本可以保护朝鲜人为名军事干预。”
en: In principle, this Japanese policy would impede the acquisition of land by Koreans and thus the first stage of osmotic expansion. In reality, Japan attempted to invert this policy into an alternative strategy to guarantee both Korean landownership and Japanese sovereignty over Koreans. After the decision to reject Korean naturalization in 1923, Japan focused on invalidating the Chinese nationality of naturalized Koreans rather than preventing Koreans from naturalizing. Simultaneously Japanese administrators envisaged exploiting naturalized Koreans to purchase land. Japan’s invalidation of Korean naturalization derived from the nationality law of the Chinese Republican government, which required foreigners to obtain the permission to become naturalized as Chinese nationals from their own governments.

This practice by Japan granted dual nationality to naturalized Koreans as Chinese nationals and Japanese subjects. Speaking about the dual nationality of Koreans as a tool used for the osmotic expansion of Japanese power, an official of the Government General of Korea stationed in the consulate of Harbin (in central Heilongjiang Province, which was referred to as North Manchuria) noted that “dual nationality of Koreans would benefit Japan for now, since it would contribute to consolidating both the economic and territorial interests of Japan. Japan can facilitate the migration of naturalized Koreans to North Manchuria and provide them with financial assistance to purchase land, and if the Chinese authorities protest this practice Japan can intervene militarily in the name of protecting Koreans.”

zh: 围绕入籍的分歧不限于在满日本行政代理人，还涉及东京内阁中的上级。例如，1930年东京内阁就允许朝鲜人入籍形成新共识时，日本拓务省表示同意。但日本外务省反对，理由之一是这会加剧东北政府对朝鲜人的压迫。
这两省之间的不和已持续数年。例如1918年他们同意把边境地区——间岛与东边道——置于朝鲜总督府管辖之下。但两省分别支持关东厅和奉天总领事，争夺间岛以外满洲地区的最高管辖权。
尽管日本首相1919年把满洲事务交由关东厅负责，这一决定并未完全厘清行政等级。据1922年东边道警察部队报告，他们被要求同时向关东厅与领事馆报告，这妨碍了对朝鲜抵抗的有效控制。
此外，尽管日本内阁各省试图把朝鲜总督府的权威限制于边境地区，总督府仍继续主持满洲其他地区的朝鲜人事务。
en: The disagreement over naturalization was not limited to Japanese administrative agents in Manchuria but also involved their superiors in the Tokyo Cabinet. For instance, when a new consensus over permission for Korean naturalization emerged in the Tokyo Cabinet in 1930, the Japanese Ministry of Colonial Affairs concurred. But the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs opposed it on the grounds, among others, that it would intensify the oppression of Koreans by the Northeast government.

The dissension between these two ministries had been going on for several years. For instance, in 1918 they agreed to place the border region—Kando and Tongbyŏndo— under the jurisdiction of the Government General of Korea. But they competed in promoting the Kwantung Administration and consul general of Fengtian, respectively, as the foremost power in Manchuria except Kando.

Although the Japanese prime minister placed the Kwantung administration in charge of Manchurian affairs in 1919, this decision did not completely clarify the administrative hierarchy. According to the report of the police forces in Tongbyŏndo in 1922, they were required to report to both the Kwantung Administration and the consulates, which impeded effective control of the Korean resistance.

Moreover, although the ministries of the Japanese Cabinet tried to confine the authority of the Government General of Korea to the border region, the Government General of Korea continued to preside over Korean affairs in other parts of Manchuria.

zh: 结果，渗透扩张在未能确保朝鲜人日本国籍或其土地所有权的情况下推进。日本利用已入籍朝鲜人购地的企图促使东北政府限制乃至取缔朝鲜人入籍，后文将讨论。日本在整个1920年代从未解决朝鲜人国籍问题。
满洲（除间岛外）的渗透扩张由东亚劝业株式会社与日本领事馆主导，它们取得土地并发展对朝鲜人及该地区的主权。
en: As a result, osmotic expansion advanced without ensuring the Japanese nationality of Koreans or their rights to landownership. The Japanese attempt to use naturalized Koreans to purchase land prompted the Northeast government to restrain and even outlaw Korean naturalization, as will be discussed later. Japan never resolved the issue of Korean nationality during the 1920s.
Osmotic expansion in Manchuria (except in Kando) was directed by the Asia Development Company and Japanese consulates, which acquired land and developed sovereignty over Koreans and the region.

zh: 取得对土地的主权
en: Attaining Sovereignty over Land

zh: 土地是朝鲜人生计不可或缺的基础，也是日本领土扩张渗透策略的主要载体。尽管日本个人也取得土地租给朝鲜人，但把朝鲜人与日本渗透策略交织在一起的主要是东亚劝业株式会社。朝鲜总督府如此解释该会社的目的：“由于扩大水稻种植的重要性，保护朝鲜人农业与生计是满洲开发及日本统治朝鲜人政策的中心。”
1921年，该会社由关东厅、外务省与东洋拓殖创立。除满铁与东洋拓殖外，朝鲜总督府与关东厅是主要出资者，尽管其年度出资低于承诺数额。
en: Land was the indispensable basis of Korean livelihood, as well as the principal vehicle of Japan’s osmotic strategy of territorial expansion. Although Japanese individuals also acquired land and rented it to Koreans, it was mainly the Asia Development Company that interlaced Koreans with the Japanese osmotic strategy. As the Government General of Korea explained the purpose of the company: “Because of the importance of the expansion of rice farming, the protection of Korean agriculture and livelihood is central to the development of Manchuria and the Japanese policy to govern Koreans.”

In 1921, the company was established by the Kwantung Administration, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the Oriental Development Company. In addition to the smrc and the Oriental Development Company, the Government General of Korea and the Kwantung Administration were the primary financiers, although their annual contributions fell short of the pledged amount.

zh: 为规避租地限制，东亚劝业采取各种方法。它以中国人与已入籍朝鲜人的名义向中国地主租地。它还试图与中国个人及东北政府建立合资企业。此外，它聘用中国人担任农场经理，或招收中国农民为佃户。即使从地主租地或与中国官员达成协议后，会社仍被迫与东北政府重新谈判以使契约与土地使用生效。
1925年，会社共经营九个农场（包括一个在蒙古），但其中只有六个似乎取得某种稳定，而这六个中的四个由中国人经理经营或雇用中国佃农。
en: To evade the restriction on leasing land, the Asia Development Company adopted various methods. It leased land from Chinese landlords under the names of Chinese and naturalized Koreans. It also sought to establish joint ventures with Chinese individuals and the Northeast government. In addition, it hired Chinese as managers of its farms or Chinese peasants as tenants. Even after leasing land from landowners or in agreements with Chinese officials, the company was forced to renegotiate with the Northeast government to validate the contract and the use of the land.

In 1925, the company operated a total of nine farms (including one in Mongolia), though only six of them, four of which were run by Chinese managers or employed Chinese tenants, seemed to have achieved some stability.

zh: 会社渴望主要从事水稻种植，尽管由于土地与设施条件不同，各农场水田比例各异。由于水田产出远高于旱田、大米价格高于其他谷物，会社偏好朝鲜人佃农，因为他们以灌溉与水稻种植专长闻名。水田价格是旱田的三倍、未耕地的六十倍。因此朝鲜人佃农为土地增值。到1925年，会社已有 479 户朝鲜佃户。
同年，最大的奉天农场招佃约 450 户朝鲜人耕种1,339町步（chŏngbo）水田。
东亚劝业把日本与朝鲜人的关系转化为地主与佃农的关系。这一转化也影响朝鲜人与中国人的关系，例如灌溉设施成为冲突来源，导致日本当局与东北政府的干预。
en: The company aspired to engage primarily in rice farming, although the proportion of paddy fields varied by farm due to the different conditions of land and facilities. Since paddy fields yield far more than dry fields and the price of rice was higher than other grains, the company preferred Koreans as tenants, as they were known for their expertise in irrigation and rice cultivation. The price of paddy fields was three times the price of dry fields and sixty times the price of untilled land. Hence Korean tenants added value to the land. By 1925, the company had hired 479 Korean households as tenants.
In the same year, the largest Fengtian farm hired about 450 Korean households to cultivate 1,339 chŏngbo of paddy fields.

The Asia Development Company transformed the relationship between Japan and Koreans into one between landlord and tenant. This transformation also affected the relationship between Koreans and Chinese, as irrigation facilities, for instance, became a source of conflict and led to the intervention of the Japanese authorities and the Northeast government.

zh: 东亚劝业成为普通朝鲜人能借到钱的主要金融机构。由于缺乏可作中国银行贷款抵押的资产，大多数朝鲜人不得不向中国地主借贷。中国小债权人收取月息8%至10%，尽管一些地主收取年息30%至100%也并不罕见。东亚劝业为朝鲜人提供了替代选择。以年息6%至8%，会社贷款给朝鲜人覆盖耕作与生活开支。以约1%的年息，会社还向朝鲜人组织经营的信用协会提供资金。此外，东亚劝业到1932年设立八个朝鲜人信用组合，资助会员把未耕地与旱田改造为水田、集体购买必需品或出售收获谷物。最大的安东信用组合有3,750名会员，其余各有数百名。用朝鲜总督府的话说，朝鲜人欢迎信用组合，犹如久旱逢甘霖。
en: The Asia Development Company became the major financial organization accessible to ordinary Koreans. Since they lacked assets to use as collateral for loans from Chinese banks, most Koreans had to borrow from Chinese landlords. The small Chinese creditors charged a monthly interest rate of 8 to 10 percent, although it was not rare for some landlords to charge an annual rate of 30 to 100 percent. The Asia Development Company offered Koreans an alternative. At an annual interest rate of 6 to 8 percent, the company loaned Koreans money to cover their expenses for cultivation and living. With an annual interest rate of about 1 percent, the company also funded credit associations run by Korean organizations. Furthermore, the Asia Development Company established eight Korean credit unions by 1932, which financed their members to transform untilled land and dry fields in paddy fields and collectively purchase necessities or sell harvested grain. The largest, Andong credit union, had 3,750 members, while others had a few hundred. In the words of the Government General of Korea, Koreans welcomed the credit unions as if they were the rain after a long drought.

zh: 渗透扩张需要能够把取得土地变成日本对这片地域的主权的行政机构。宣称对朝鲜人拥有司法权威的日本领事馆履行了这一任务。它们执行外交职能、中介本国政府与海外侨民，履行签发护照、保护生命财产等任务。除这些通常活动外，领事馆还侵蚀中国对该地区的官方主权。1915年条约允许日本在南满设立五个领事馆。1920年代日本试图增加该地区领事馆数量，重新引发围绕条约的争端。中国的反对依据要求日本臣民服从中国法律的条款。日本要求更多领事馆则援引规定双方就此问题进一步谈判的辅助条款。日本反对对其保护本国臣民权利的否认。
en: Osmotic expansion required administrative institutions that could translate the acquisition of land into Japan’s sovereignty over the occupied land. Japanese consulates, which claimed judicial authority over Koreans, performed this task. They carried out diplomatic functions and mediated between the home government and its overseas residents, performing tasks such as issuing passports and protecting lives and property. Beyond these usual activities, the consulates also breached China’s official sovereignty over the region. The 1915 Treaty permitted Japan to establish five consulates in South Manchuria. Japan’s attempt to increase the number of consulates in the region in the 1920s renewed disputes over the treaty. The Chinese objection drew on a clause that required Japanese subjects to submit to Chinese laws. The Japanese demand for more consulates alluded to an auxiliary clause that provided for further negotiation between the two parties over this issue. Japan objected to the denial of its right to protect its own subjects.

zh: 不顾激烈反对，日本扩张了其领事馆。它主张驻屯领事警察权是治外法权的必然结果，理由是警察力量为履行领事法院司法职能所必需。到1931年，日本已在满洲五地设立领事馆（包括间岛），其警察派出所约六百个，配备警察约三万名。中国人汇编了1920年代日军非法行动事件清单。例如，日军在满洲各地举行军事演习，毁坏农田、伤害中国平民。他们还协助在南满与中满叛乱的蒙古土匪。此外，他们逮捕中国平民并攻击中国军队。
尽管有这种对中国主权的侵蚀，日本领事馆的能力似乎几乎未能达到管理朝鲜人口的目标。例如，即使在容纳南满四个领事分馆中三个的山区东边道，某县也只有一名警察负责镇压朝鲜独立运动。
当日本试图在东边道临江县设立领事馆时，该县知事驱逐110户（560人）。这一事件促使其他县知事命令其官员驱逐朝鲜人、没收其土地。
en: Over fierce opposition, Japan expanded its consulates. It asserted its right to station consular police as a corollary to the right of extraterritoriality on the grounds that police forces were necessary to perform the judicial functions of the consular courts. By 1931, Japanese consulates had been established at five locations in Manchuria, including Kando, and its subpolice stations numbered about six hundred, staffed with about thirty thousand policemen. The Chinese compiled a list of incidents of illegal expeditions by Japanese forces during the 1920s. For example, Japanese forces conducted military maneuvers across Manchuria, which destroyed farmland and injured Chinese civilians. They also assisted Mongol bandits who rebelled in South and Central Manchuria. In addition, they arrested Chinese civilians and launched attacks on Chinese forces.

Despite such encroachments on Chinese sovereignty, the capacity of the Japanese consulates hardly seems to have met the objective of administering the Korean population. For instance, even in the mountainous Tongbyŏndo area, which housed three of the four subconsulates in South Manchuria, in one county only one policeman was in charge of pacifying the Korean independence movement.

When Japan sought to create a consulate in Imgang County in Tongbyŏndo, the county magistrate evicted 110 households (560 people). This incident prompted other county magistrates to order their officials to expel Koreans and confiscate their lands.

zh: 为弥补人数不足，日本领事馆试图把朝鲜人组织作为附属机构管理。朝鲜人组织与日本领事馆之间的关系，可以从保民会（Pominhoe）的历史看出——第三章将把它与朝鲜人民会（Korean Association）比较。
该会1921年由朝鲜一进会前成员倡议创立——一进会是朝鲜的亲日组织，推动日本吞并朝鲜。援引日本保护朝鲜人的一般政策，该会旨在帮助朝鲜人改善家庭经济、镇压各种流亡运动。
在朝鲜总督府与日本外务省的财政支持下，该会把总部设在奉天总领事馆，在南满其他地区有一百多个支部。朝鲜总督府不仅向该会提供武器，还向其总部派遣警察。

children: 〔校注〕原书英文作 Korean Association，据原书术语表（Chosŏnin minhoe，汉字朝鮮人民會）译朝鲜人民会，全书统一；1935年联合会 Chonsŏnin minhoe yŏnhaphoe 译全朝鲜人民会联合会。

en: To offset their low numbers, the Japanese consulates attempted to manage Korean organizations as subsidiaries. The relationship between Korean organizations and Japanese consulates is well illustrated by the history of the Association for the Protection of People (Pominhoe), which will be compared to the Korean Association in chapter 3.

The association was founded in 1921 on the initiatives of former members of Ilchinhoe of Korea—a pro-Japanese organization in Korea that promoted the annexation of Korea by Japan. Invoking Japan’s general policy of protecting Koreans, the association aimed to help Koreans to improve their household economy and suppress various exile movements.

With financial support from the Government General of Korea and the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the association established its headquarters in the consulate general in Fengtian, with more than one hundred branches in other parts of South Manchuria. The Government General of Korea not only supplied the association with weapons, but it also dispatched its policemen to the association’s headquarters.

zh: 日本各权力试图合理化行政管辖并统一朝鲜人组织。为使领事馆单独控制保民会，日本外务省要求朝鲜总督府收回给该会的武器并停止财政援助。在奉天总领事指导下，该会整合其他朝鲜人组织——朝鲜人居留民会（Chosŏnin kŏryumihoe）与农民组合（Nongmin chohap）。
但这些措施似乎未能确保日本对朝鲜人的主权。朝鲜人组织的整合名义多于实际。朝鲜人组织保留自己名称而为保民会工作的情况并不罕见。奉天总领事未能防止会内的非法活动与腐败。该会在谴责流亡独立运动收取强制会费、勒索其他捐献的同时，自己却诉诸类似做法。其领导人还被控内讧与挪用公款。为防止混乱与腐败，总领事1923年解散该会。
en: Japanese powers attempted to rationalize the administrative jurisdiction and unify Korean organizations. For sole control over the Association for the Protection of People by consulates, the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs asked the Government General of Korea to withdraw weaponry given to the association and discontinue its financial assistance. Under the direction of the consul general of Fengtian, the association integrated other Korean organizations—the Korean Residents’ Association (Chosŏnin kŏryumihoe) and the Farmers’ Association (Nongmin chohap).

Yet these measures seem to have failed to ensure Japanese sovereignty over Koreans. The integration of Korean organizations was more nominal than actual. It was not rare for Korean organizations to retain their names while working for the Association for the Protection of People. The consul general of Fengtian failed to prevent illicit activities and corruption within the association. While condemning the exiled independence movement for collecting compulsory membership fees and extorting other donations, the association resorted to similar practices. Its leaders were also charged with infighting and appropriating official funds for private use. To prevent disorder and corruption, the consul general dismantled the association in 1923.

zh: 日本与东北政府合作镇压朝鲜独立运动，导致1925年朝鲜总督府与奉天政府之间签订条约。1925年条约包含关于东边道地区的两项协定。奉天政府同意平定反叛朝鲜人团体，日本承诺不越境镇压。此外，奉天政府誓言若获准监视朝鲜人迁移，则允许朝鲜人在当地居住耕作。条约后，奉天政府提议把朝鲜人组织为集体监视团，并发放每两年检查一次的居留许可。朝鲜人若愿迁往其他地区，须取得迁移许可。尽管1925年条约以中日联合警务管制朝鲜人而臭名昭著，它并未阻止日本派军镇压朝鲜抵抗。因此它未能保障朝鲜人的居留，更谈不上其在该地区耕作的权利。
en: Japan collaborated with the Northeast government to suppress Korean independence movements, which led to the signing of a treaty in 1925 between the Government General of Korea and the Fengtian government. The 1925 treaty entailed two accords concerning the Tongbyŏndo region. The Fengtian government agreed to pacify rebellious Korean groups, while Japan promised not to cross the border to suppress them. In addition, the Fengtian government vowed to permit Koreans to reside and farm there if it were allowed to monitor the migration of Koreans. After the treaty, the Fengtian government proposed to organize Koreans into collective surveillance teams and issue residence permits with biennial inspections. If Koreans wished to move to other regions, they were required to obtain a migration permit. Despite its notoriety for the joint policing of Koreans by Chinese and Japanese, the 1925 treaty did not prevent Japan from sending its armies to suppress Korean resistance. It therefore did not assure the residency of Koreans, let alone their right to farm in the region.

zh: 渗透政治横跨日本行政组织取得土地与扩张领事馆的两项艰苦努力。渗透政治的意义在于：朝鲜人不仅通过警务、还通过向其提供土地与贷款的社会计划被绑定于日本权力。这意味着把朝鲜人从日本权力中解脱出来需要替代日本的社会计划。东北政府没有拥抱这一选项，而是旨在区分朝鲜移民与中国移民：将前者排除出去、把后者转化为土地所有者。
en: Osmotic politics straddled two strenuous efforts by Japanese administrative organizations to acquire land and expand the consulates. The significance of osmotic politics is that Koreans were bound to Japanese power not just through policing but also through social programs that supplied Koreans with land and loans. This means that extricating Koreans from Japanese power would require replacing the Japanese social program. Instead of embracing this option, the Northeast government aimed to make a distinction between Korean and Chinese migrants, eliminating the former and turning the latter into landowners.

zh: 生产中国民族
en: producing the chinese nation

zh: 在日本渗透推进之中，现代中国国家主权在满洲以土地、人民、领土三位一体来表达。朝鲜人流入满洲的加剧催生了丧失土地与领土主权的恐惧。1911年，满朝边境县汪清县的一份报告称，每天约有一百名朝鲜人渡过图们江抵达间岛。
据该报告，中国警察减缓朝鲜移民的最初尝试徒劳无功，因为人数太多。1912年，同县另一份报告以中朝之间“反客为主”关系讽刺地描述朝鲜人的大量涌入。它警告，朝鲜移民的增加可能激化与日本的外交争端——日本将利用朝鲜人渗透间岛。
1928年，间岛各县知事仍对蜂拥而至的朝鲜移民表示惊恐。
en: In the midst of Japan’s osmotic advance, modern Chinese state sovereignty in Manchuria was expressed in terms of the triad of land, people, and territory. The increasing flow of Koreans to Manchuria fostered the fear of losing sovereignty over land and territory. In 1911, a report from Wangch’ŏng County, a border county between Manchuria and Korea, claimed that about one hundred Koreans were crossing the Tuman River and arriving in Kando every day.

According to the report, the initial attempt by Chinese policemen to slow Korean immigration had been futile, as the numbers were too large. In 1912, another report from the same county sardonically described the heavy flow of Koreans in terms of “reverse host-guest” relations between the Chinese and Koreans. It warned that the increase in Korean migration could inflame diplomatic disputes with Japan, which would use Koreans to infiltrate Kando.
In 1928, magistrates of the counties in Kando were still expressing alarm over swarming Korean emigrants.

zh: 以属地原则界定民族成员身份，开始成为联结土地、人民与领土的方式。日本渗透扩张推进之地间岛的汪清县知事1911年总结道：
en: The territorial principle of national membership emerged as a unifier of land, people, and territory. The magistrate of Wangch’ŏng County in Kando, where the Japanese osmotic expansion advanced, summed it up in 1911:

children: 当日本1910年殖民朝鲜时，朝鲜人失去国家，因而失去朝鲜国籍。日本无权强迫朝鲜人成为日本臣民……日本或许有权训斥朝鲜人、有义务保护朝鲜人，但它不拥有干涉朝鲜人自身国籍选择的特权……当代知识分子评价属地主义〔朝鲜语sokchi chuŭi，中文shudi zhuyi〕为当今启蒙时代的新观念，与过时的属人主义〔朝鲜语sogin chuŭi，中文shuren zhuyi〕相对。若日本自称为启蒙国家……它就必须接受属地主义……当日本在日本国内依属地原则确定民族成员身份时，为何日本在中国却实行属人主义[把朝鲜人主张为其臣民]？

对朝鲜人构成威胁的担忧蔓延到满洲的间岛以外地区。民族成员身份的属地原则由中国民族力量强制执行。张作霖的东北政府与商人共同体尽管在中国民族的领土边界与族群身份上存在分歧，却在彼此矛盾的领土政治与资本主义政治中合作，推行以领土为依据的民族成员身份。领土政治把中国国民与朝鲜移民截然对立，资本主义政治却把两个群体带入土地交换与劳动的复杂社会关系，否定了这种透明的二分。领土政治塑造了要求朝鲜人离开满洲的民族主义法律，而这一法律受资本主义政治限制。领土与资本主义政治为东北政府与商人资产阶级提供了对中国土地所有者与农民的民族霸权。

When Japan colonized Korea in 1910, Koreans lost their nation and thus Korean nationality. Japan is not entitled to force Koreans to become Japanese subjects. . . . While Japan might have the right to reprimand Koreans and the obligation to protect Koreans, it does not possess the prerogative to interfere with Koreans’ own choice of nationality. . . . Contemporary intellectuals appraise the territorial principle [sokchi chuŭi in Korean, shudi zhuyi in Chinese] as a new idea of the present period of enlightenment as opposed to the obsolete ethnic principle [sogin chuŭi in Korean, shuren zhuyi in Chinese]. If Japan claims itself to be an enlightened country . . . it must accept the territorial principle. . . . When Japanese national membership has drawn on the territorial principle within Japan, why does Japan practice the ethnic principle in China [by claiming Koreans as its subjects]?

The perceived threat of Koreans spread through Manchuria beyond Kando region. The territorial principle of national membership was enforced by Chinese national forces. Zhang Zuolin’s Northeast government and the merchant community, despite their differences on the territorial boundaries and ethnic identity of the Chinese nation, collaborated to command the territorializing national membership in paradoxical territorial and capitalist politics. Whereas territorial politics diametrically opposed Chinese nationals and Korean migrants, capitalist politics brought both groups together in complex social relations of land exchange and labor that defied such a transparent dichotomy. While territorial politics fashioned the nationalist law that required Koreans to leave Manchuria, this law was limited by capitalist politics. Territorial and capitalist politics provided the Northeast government and merchant bourgeoisie with national hegemony over Chinese landowners and peasants.

zh: 对土地所有者的民族霸权
en: National Hegemony over Landowners

zh: 始于1922年的改革标志着中国民族形成的关键时刻。除促进本国产业的政策外，垦殖与开发计划（Colonial and Development Plan）为以民族发展为目标的满洲开发增加了中国劳动力。中国农民多为来自华北的成年男性，停留一季或至多几年，尽管家庭迁移并非不存在。奉天政府激励他们在满洲定居更长时间——即便不是永久——并取得一定成功。正如罗纳德·苏莱斯基所解释，该计划旨在把中国移民增加到每年20万户、即至少40万人，同时延长其停留时间。为招募移民，政府官员被派往主要港口与大城市铁路枢纽，包括沈阳、大连、长春与哈尔滨。官员把新移民纳入政府计划，提供特别身份证、华资铁路减价票与定居财政援助。约一半新移民被送往吉林、黑龙江两省垦荒与经营牧场。其余被导向林业、矿业与制糖业工作。此外，新移民获三至五年免税，以及居住五年后以低于市价购买土地与住宅的机会。这一移民政策取得一定成功。中国农民移民1923至1930年翻了一番。到1920年代末，约40%的入境移民停留三年，19%停留至少四年。
en: Reforms dating from 1922 marked a key moment in the formation of the Chinese nation. In addition to the policies that promoted national industries, the Colonial and Development Plan expanded the Chinese workforce for the national development of Manchuria. Chinese peasants tended to be male adults from North China who stayed one season or a few years at most, though family migration was not absent. The Fengtian government motivated them, with some success, to settle in Manchuria for longer periods, if not permanently. As Ronald Suleski explains, the plan was intended to increase the number of Chinese migrants to 200,000 households, or at least 400,000 people annually, while lengthening the duration of their stay. To recruit migrants, government officials were sent to major ports and railway terminals in major cities, including Shenyang, Dairen, Changchun, and Harbin. The officials enlisted new recruits in government programs, providing them with special identification cards, reduced fares on Chinese-owned railways, and financial assistance for settlement. About half of the new migrants were sent to Jilin and Heilongjiang Provinces to reclaim wasteland and run ranches. The rest were directed to jobs in forestry, mining, and sugar refining. In addition, new migrants were offered tax exemptions for three to five years, as well as the opportunity to purchase land and dwellings at below-market prices after five years of residence. This migration policy enjoyed some success. The migration of Chinese peasants doubled from 1923 to 1930. By the late 1920s, about 40 percent of the entering migrants were staying for three years and 19 percent were staying for at least four years.

zh: 除经济效果外，在我看来该计划创造了东北政府与商人资产阶级对中国土地所有者与农民的霸权。正如日本对朝鲜移民的主权依托于承诺帮助他们成为土地所有者的社会计划，东北政府对中国移民的主权也取决于该计划提供的类似社会计划。因此满洲土地所有者与农民之间的边界是流动的。在中国本部，由大地主构成的强大士绅阶级阻碍农业资本主义发展。其对应物在满洲缺席。东北政府与资产阶级对地主的支配带有鲜明的资本主义性质。如前所述，东北政府是银行、粮栈与食品加工厂的主要出资者。地主与生产者依赖商人或称为粮栈的谷物批发商号——它们控制了满洲约 40% 的大豆贸易。大豆是主要经济作物。
地方商人从乡下收购作物，转售给城市中心或车站附近的大商人，后者分销给商店、食品加工厂与出口商。
en: Beyond its economic effects, the plan in my view created the hegemony of the Northeast government and merchant bourgeoisie over Chinese landowners and peasants. Just as Japan’s sovereignty over Korean migrants rested on a social program that promised to help them become landowners, the Northeast government’s sovereignty over the Chinese migrants hinged on a similar social program provided by the plan. The boundary between landowners and peasants was therefore fluid in Manchuria. In China proper, the powerful gentry class made up of large landlords inhibited capitalist development of agriculture. Its counterpart was absent in Manchuria. The domination of the Northeast government and bourgeoisie over landlords bore a distinctly capitalist character. As was explained earlier, the Northeast government was the primary financier for banks, grain stores, and food-processing factories. Landlords and producers depended on merchants or wholesale grain stores called liangchan, which controlled about 40 percent of the entire soybean trade in Manchuria, a primary cash crop.

Local merchants bought crops from the countryside and resold them to larger merchants of urban centers or near railway stations, who distributed them to stores, food processing factories, and exporters.

zh: 把土地表象为“国土”使东北政府与商人得以维持对土地所有者的控制。将财产权纳入国家主权框架，诉诸公民与通敌者之间泾渭分明的划分。民国政府外交部1925年的一份声明抓住了财产法作为日本渗透政治对策的紧迫性：“日本计划购地并迁朝鲜人居住，以永久殖民该地区。愚昧中国人只图私利，把土地交给朝鲜人。结果，我国主权丧失。”
至少从1924到1929年，东北政府与民国中央政府密切沟通，反复就中国土地所有者与外国人——尤其朝鲜人——之间土地房屋的社会契约发布法令。由于无条件续约意味着事实所有权，续约被禁止。
向外国人出售或出租土地房屋须县署批准。以土地作抵押向日本金融组织贷款也被禁止，以预防日本夺取抵押土地。此外，禁止出租房屋体现了把朝鲜人排斥出当地的决心。土地交易规制并非总是来自上层，也由公民团体规定。例如，辽宁国民外交协会1929年要求辽宁（原奉天）省政府颁布法律保全国土、惩罚向朝鲜人出售任何国土者。
据该协会，日本侵略不仅利用朝鲜人，还说服中国人卖地。
